items.source: To use internally generated ids, annotate an arbitrary attribute of type java.lang.long or java.lang.Long with @Id and @GeneratedValue.
items.translation: 若要使用内部生成的 ID，请将类型为java.lang.long或java.lang.Long的任意属性用@Id和@GeneratedValue进行注解。

items.source: To use externally generated ids, annotate an arbitrary attribute with a type that your generated returns with @Id and @GeneratedValue and specify the generator class.
items.translation: 若要使用外部生成的 ID，请使用 `@Id` 和 @GeneratedValue 注解任意属性类型（该类型由您的生成器返回），并指定生成器类。

items.source: To use assigned ids, annotate an arbitrary attribute of your domain class with Id or this annotation:
items.translation: 若要使用分配的 ID，请在您的领域类的任意属性上标注 Id 或此注解：

items.source: This annotation is included here for completeness. It marks an attribute as the primary id of a node entity. It can be used as an alternative to Id and it may provide additional features in the future.
items.translation: 此处包含此注释是为了完整性。它标记一个属性为节点实体的主 id。它可以作为Id的替代方案，并且未来可能会提供额外的功能。

items.source:
@Node
public class MyEntity {
        @Id String theId;
}
You can combine @Id with @Property with assigned ids to rename the node property in which the assigned id is stored.
items.translation:
@Node
public class MyEntity {
        @Id String theId;
}
您可以将 @Id 与带有指定 ID 的 @Property 组合使用，以重命名存储该指定 ID 的节点属性。

items.source:
@Node
public class MyEntity {
        @Id @GeneratedValue Long id;
}
It does not need to be named id, but most people chose this as the attribute in the class. As the attribute does not correspond to a node property, it cannot be renamed via @Property.
items.translation:
@Node
public class MyEntity {
        @Id @GeneratedValue Long id;
}
它不必命名为id，但大多数人会选择将其作为类中的属性。由于该属性不对应节点属性，因此无法通过@Property进行重命名。

items.source:
@Node
public class MyEntity {
        @Id @GeneratedValue(UUIDStringGenerator.class) String theId;
}
Externally generated ids are indistinguishable to assigned ids from the database perspective and thus can be arbitrarily named via @Property.
items.translation:
@Node
public class MyEntity {
        @Id @GeneratedValue(UUIDStringGenerator.class) String theId;
}
从数据库的角度来看，外部生成的 ID 与分配的 ID 无法区分，因此可以通过 @Property 任意命名。
